contracts_rationale: Bug fix to existing generated-output fields; no new interface. The changed contract (absolute source, OKF link form) is recorded in ADR-0037/ADR-0059 addendum.
purpose_context: Consumer sites deployed under a base path (e.g. GitHub Pages project sites) get 404ing links from two generated outputs: the per-page agent JSON source field (#236) and links between pages in the OKF export bundle (#237). This mission fixes both so generated outputs agree with the HTML site and with each other.
purpose_tldr: Make the agent-API page record and the OKF export emit links that work on sites served under a base path.
